headline: A selection of luxury apartments in the historic heart of Burton-upon-Trent
description: Crown Works is a selection of luxury apartments in the historic heart of Burton-upon-Trent — a new era of exceptional city living and country leisure designed for first-time buyers and investors seeking a more rewarding home-owning experience. Surrounded by open green space, Burton offers the best of both worlds, with good road and rail connections, a town full of amenities, and easy access to the Peak District National Park and surrounding green spaces.

specification.heading: Flooring
items: Bedroom areas fitted with contemporary carpeting

specification.heading: Kitchens
items: Double base units, double and single wall units
One and a half sink unit with chrome mixer tap
Brushed metal handles to kitchen units
Fully integrated appliances to include oven, ceramic hob, extractor, and fridge freezer as per kitchen supplier's proposals

specification.heading: Bathrooms
items: Self-contained sliding door shower cubicle with tray and overhead adjustable shower head
Full-height tiling panel to the back and side of shower cubicle
Pedestal basin with high quality chrome mixer tap with tiles as a splashback
Downlights or single ceiling light positioned as per electrical layout, switch control

locationNotes: Burton-upon-Trent is a market town in Staffordshire, internationally known as the capital of British brewing. Close to Derby, Nottingham, Leicester and Birmingham; a train to Birmingham New Street takes just 23 minutes. East Midlands Airport and Birmingham International Airport are a short journey away, and there is easy access to the Peak District National Park.
